name: Katou Megumi
source:
Hobbies: Shopping (Secret: Um, is it even normal to have a hobby that you can't mention?)

Megumi is [url=/c36124]Tomoya's[/url] classmate. Unlike [url=/c25934]Eriri[/url] and [url=/c25935]Utaha[/url], she is portrayed as an ordinary girl with no distinctive character. She is a good-looking girl but doesn't stand out in class at all; she is very stealthy and it's not unusual to find her checking mobile phone and becoming a part of the background even if she started a conversation. She knows little about otaku culture but never keeps Tomoya at arm's length. Her attitude toward Tomoya is often described as furatto (フラット) and he is often the unfortunate target of snide, deadpan retorts from her. She is the model for Meguri, one of the main heroines of the game being produced by Blessing Software.

(Source: [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saekano:_How_to_Raise_a_Boring_Girlfriend]Wikipedia[/url] & [url=http://www.saekano.com/character/]Saekano Offical Site[/url])
